World (terrain × climate):
Layer:

What to look for — temperature: mountains as distinct cold patches (elevation drives the spread). precip: mountains wet, their lee dry (rain shadow); tropical world wet / subtropical world dry. NPP: green where warm AND wet; low where cold OR dry. biome: EMERGES from Whittaker(T,P) — tropical→forest, subtropical→desert, temperate→forest/grass mosaic.
